title: Session Results Response
description: 200 response of POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/results, served by both the classic and the typed handler. continue_optimization is the Backend's advice on whether the client should keep requesting trials: false once the session is finalized, stopped, or has reached its trial budget. The Python SDK only logs it. Closed: the three keys below are every key either handler serves; a new key is a contract change made here first.

success.description: True when the results were accepted (including an idempotent re-submit of an already recorded trial).

continue_optimization.description: Whether the client should keep requesting trials after this submission.

message.description: Fixed human-readable acknowledgement; the second form is served when the trial was already recorded.
